open.text: a whole army lost to *one sage.*

script: A king rode up with his army to a sage's forest home. The sage fed every soldier, with a wonder cow that could give anything. The king wanted her. The sage said no. So the king tried to take her by force. And his whole army lost, to one old man with a staff. The king gave up his throne. After years of practice, he became a great sage himself: Vishvamitra. And the prayer he's remembered for doesn't ask for power, or to win. The Gayatri, the prayer millions of Hindus say every morning, asks for one thing. A clear mind. Before a big test, it doesn't ask for the grade. It asks to see straight.
